description: Appears when rows are selected and operates on the selection as a set. Renders nothing at a count of zero.

count.description: How many rows are selected. Zero renders no bar at all.

actions.description: The actions offered for the current selection.

run.description: An action was activated, carrying which one.

clearable.description: Whether the Clear control is drawn. Every layer gates on this member and never on whether anything listens for `clear`, per R6.
